description: This file defines a benchmark test suite for measuring app startup and scroll frame timings on Android devices. It uses the AndroidX Benchmark library and UI Automator to perform performance tests such as cold start and warm start with scrolling.

classes.name: StartupMacrobenchmark
classes.description: A class containing performance benchmark tests for app startup time and UI responsiveness using AndroidX Benchmark library.

methods.name: coldStartup
methods.description: Performs a benchmark measurement for cold app startup with 10 iterations.

methods.name: startupAndScrollFrameTiming
methods.description: Performs a benchmark measurement for warm startup combined with scrolling gestures to measure frame timing.

methods.name: runBenchmarkOrSkip
methods.description: Executes the given benchmark code, skipping the test if known device issues are detected.
